title: Exposure, hedge direction, and the basis that remains
objectives: Define a statistical exposure with the correct units and horizon
Derive OLS orthogonality and identify residual nonlinear risk
Build long and short hedge cash flows using a fixed basis convention
Compare contract choices by their combined risk rather than hoped-for gains
prerequisites: Chapters 1–3 cash-flow accounting; elementary means, variances and differentiation, developed locally where used.
source_scope: Full sequential English caption reading for positions 9–11; no comprehensive audiovisual audit. Philosophical digression treated as contextual rather than a financial theorem.
